$comment: Single source of truth for scripts/build_adapters.py. Edit this file and adapters/source/roles/*.md, then run `python scripts/build_adapters.py`. Paths that do not exist yet are skipped in indexes (llms.txt) but kept in role bodies, which tell the agent to say so instead of guessing.

plugin.description: Design, build, review and operate Telegram bots with the newest Bot API: bot screens and keyboards, streaming AI replies, HTML widgets, premium emoji, product flows, channel publishing, agent-operated bots and Bot API lookups. Bundles the telegram-bot-ui skill and five subagents.
plugin.author: hlibsuslov

codex.short_description: Design, build and operate Telegram bots with the newest Bot API: screens, keyboards, streaming AI replies with Stop, private panels in groups, Rich Messages, HTML widgets and TON wallet flows, premium emoji packs, whole product flows, channel publishing with approval, agent-operated bots and offline Bot API lookups. Preserves callback_data, deep links, handlers and translations.
codex.default_prompt: Use $telegram-bot-ui to audit this Telegram bot's screens and propose fixes.

capabilities.title: Build and audit bot interfaces
capabilities.summary: texts, inline and reply keyboards, colored and disabled buttons, navigation, forms, streaming AI replies with Stop, ephemeral replies in groups, Rich Messages, tables, formatting, localization

capabilities.title: Product flows and use cases
capabilities.summary: shops, support, AI assistants, trackers, communities: stale buttons, double submit, audience leaks

capabilities.title: Publish to Telegram channels
capabilities.summary: compose, validate, preview, approve, schedule and publish channel posts without double posting

capabilities.title: Operate as an agent through a bot
capabilities.summary: allowlisted operators, approval-bound actions, prompt injection in inbound messages, MCP bridge

capabilities.title: Build HTML widgets
capabilities.summary: Bot API 10.4 widgets: size limit, production context, caption and text fallback, widget_query, shared widgets, TON wallet

capabilities.title: Use premium emoji packs
capabilities.summary: pick one custom emoji pack, resolve real ids, apply it to buttons, texts, rich messages and posts with all-or-nothing fallback; never invent an id

capabilities.title: Look up the whole Bot API
capabilities.summary: methods, types and fields from a local catalog; validate a payload before sending; never invent a field

roles.name: telegram-bot-designer
roles.description: Audits and designs Telegram bot screens: builds the screen/state map, finds real UX defects, and proposes exact texts, keyboards and navigation using the telegram-bot-ui skill. Use for "review this bot's menu", "redesign the onboarding", "why does the bot feel confusing". Read-only: proposes, never edits code.

roles.name: telegram-bot-builder
roles.description: Implements Telegram bot features from the telegram-bot-ui recipes and validators: menus, forms, streaming replies with Stop, ephemeral panels, Rich Messages, widgets, SDK adapters for missing Bot API methods. Use when the design is agreed and code must change, with tests.

roles.name: telegram-publisher
roles.description: Composes, validates, previews and publishes Telegram channel posts through the telegram-bot-ui publishing pipeline and scripts/tg_post.py, with explicit human approval before every publish and no double posts. Use for "post this to our channel", "schedule the weekly digest", "fix how our channel posts look".

roles.name: telegram-widget-builder
roles.description: Designs and builds Bot API 10.4 HTML widgets with the telegram-bot-ui widget design system, build and preview tools and the size validator: live cards, shared polls, tickers, wallet flows. Use for "make the order status an interactive card" or "build a widget".

roles.name: telegram-bot-reviewer
roles.description: Reviews a diff of a Telegram bot against the telegram-bot-ui invariants: one action per button, preserved callback_data, audience safety, single finalization, widget limits, publishing approval, agent allowlists and injection handling, invented Bot API fields. Read-only; reports findings with file:line and the invariant broken.
